plan.disposition: small complexity — Branch A/B/C external plan review only applies medium+

findings.finding: localStatusIds's loop body was an unbraced single-line if, inconsistent with the rest of the file. FIXED: wrapped in braces, condition split onto its own lines.
findings.suggestion: Wrap the if body in braces for consistency (applied).

findings.finding: No test exercised a local status event with an INVALID newStatus alongside a later origin status for the same id. FIXED: added a test proving an invalid local status event never enters local_status_ids, so origin's valid status still applies via gap-fill.
findings.suggestion: Add a gap-fill test for an invalid local newStatus (applied).

findings.finding: Claim under doubt: The composer's module header describes ordering as "Origin sits between: it beats stale local-tracked on an equal-ts tie but loses to a pending local outbox flip" without qualifying that this tie-break is unreachable for a status id the local tree has already decided. — Confirmed the local-wins filter drops a locally-decided id's origin status event before it ever reaches resolveUnion's tie-break sort, so the sentence as written could mislead a future maintainer into thinking origin can still beat a stale local status on an equal-ts tie. It cannot -- local-wins is timestamp-blind whenever a valid local status decision exists for that id. The sentence remains literally true only for amend events and for the pure gap-fill case (no local decision at all).
findings.suggestion: Add a one-line qualifier scoping the tie-break sentence to events not subject to the local-wins rule (amend, or a status id with no local decision).
